title: Composition isomorphism for pullbacks
statement:
For morphisms $h_1\colon T\to S$ and $h_2\colon S\to R$, the *composition isomorphism*
of pullbacks

$$
(h_2\circ h_1)^*\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }h_1^*\circ h_2^*
$$

is the conjugate, under the adjunctions of
[def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction], of the inverse of the composition
isomorphism $(h_2)_*\circ(h_1)_*\cong(h_2\circ h_1)_*$ of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp].

proof.text:
By [def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction], $(h_2\circ h_1)^*$ is left adjoint to
$(h_2\circ h_1)_*$, and $h_1^*\circ h_2^*$ is left adjoint to $(h_2)_*\circ(h_1)_*$.
These two right adjoints are isomorphic by [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp]. Left
adjoints are unique up to a unique isomorphism compatible with the adjunctions, and
taking conjugates gives the isomorphism.
